title: BlockchainHQ
tagline: BlockchainHQ The ultimate super app for builders to contribute, collaborate, and unlock opportunities in the Web3 space.
description:
BlockchainHQ is the ultimate super app for builders to contribute, collaborate, and unlock opportunities in the Web3 space.

Q&A - Builders can ask questions, contribute by answering, and earn on-chain reputation scores and attestations for their contributions through the Sign Protocol.

Gigs & Work - A trustless marketplace powered by smart contracts, eliminating the need for intermediaries. To ensure fair behavior, both parties (buyer and seller) must stake crypto assets, demonstrating their commitment and accountability.

OS Fund Raise
An open-source fundraising through which builders can create campaign and raise crowdfunding for their open-source public goods.

Builders Point - A dedicated space where builders and teams can create "Request for Contribution" posts, including:

1) Recruiting early beta testers for their startup
2) Seeking feedback and suggestions or constructive criticism with Roast My DApp
3) Conducting user research interviews
4) Proposing team collaboration or co-founder opportunities
5) Finding content writers and educators
6) Requesting media coverage
how_its_made:
Let's start with the first step, which is user onboarding. For ease of user experience, we have integrated Capsule to enable a wallet-less sign-in experience.

Gig & Work is our marketplace through which users can buy/sell digital services or digital goods such as software products, etc. To eliminate the need for intermediaries in the gig marketplace, for every gig project, funds from the buyer's side will be locked in a smart contract until the seller/freelancer completes the work.

This is going to be a multichain marketplace where users can choose the chain on which they want to stake their assets.

After completing the transaction, a seller will gain on-chain reputation. Additionally, after completing certain projects, builders will earn proof-of-work attestation using the Sign Protocol.

An AI agent will tip tokens to builders using XMTP for their contributions, such as answering community questions and completing certain tasks.

Q&A - Users can ask questions and contribute by answering according to their expertise. Users will earn tokens for their contributions. To ensure the platform is not exploited by bad actors spamming answers to earn rewards, we are using Vlayer ZK email and NFT gating so that only builders with certain credibility can answer questions.
